scripts.preflight:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd <ROOT>/framework
mkdir -p <ROOT>/task/.tmp/fixture-run-preflight/compute-slots && chmod 700 <ROOT>/task/.tmp/fixture-run-preflight/compute-slots
mkdir -p <ROOT>/task/.tmp/fixture-run-preflight/gsim-slots && chmod 700 <ROOT>/task/.tmp/fixture-run-preflight/gsim-slots
exec taskset -c 3,4 /usr/bin/env -i HOME=/selected/home LANG=C.UTF-8 LOGNAME=ubuntu MERLIN_BUNDLE_CAS=<ROOT>/task/.tmp/fixture-run-preflight/bundle-cas MERLIN_CAPSULE_ORDER=information-first MERLIN_CODEX_CPUS=3,4 MERLIN_COMPUTE_CPUS=3,4 MERLIN_COMPUTE_CPU_SLOTS=<ROOT>/task/.tmp/fixture-run-preflight/compute-slots MERLIN_GRADE_WORKERS=20 MERLIN_GSIM_SLOT_ROOT=<ROOT>/task/.tmp/fixture-run-preflight/gsim-slots 'MERLIN_JOINT_PERFORMANCE_SELECTION={"path": "<ROOT>/launch-out/performance-selection.json", "sha256": "7e705446772c5d8515ded933f9721fc9452d7013d07ad5d9526f4f1b37dcee31"}' MERLIN_PREPARATION_CPUS=3,4 USER=ubuntu /selected/python -m merlin_experiments.phase1 --descriptor <ROOT>/framework/inputs/source-release/payload/experiment/target_experiment.yaml --bundle-manifest <ROOT>/framework/inputs/source-release/payload/experiment/input_bundles/b/input_bundle_manifest.yaml --corpus-seal <ROOT>/framework/inputs/source-release/private/seal.json --compiler-library-root <ROOT>/library-root --compiler-library-contract <ROOT>/launch-out/selected-library-contract.json --compiler-library-contract-sha256 cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc --codex-home-root <ROOT>/task/private/codex-fixture-run-preflight --max-wall-s 7200 --sim-max-jobs 20 --operator-errata <ROOT>/launch-out/author-guidance.md --run-id fixture-run-preflight --joint-campaign <ROOT>/launch-out/policy.json --full-compiler-root <ROOT>/framework/inputs/full-compiler/python --full-compiler-manifest <ROOT>/framework/inputs/full-compiler/manifest.json --full-compiler-manifest-sha256 e0c71b9f9be6d1b82b39dfc3afc49a183d938943eb4aa253e320632d439f4e9e --max-rate-limit-waits 24 --fresh-backend --author-token-unbounded --preflight-only
